story.en: ...You're cold, right. Let's step in here for a moment.

story.text: 이 '찻집', 저 혼자 올 때도 가끔 와요. 조용해서.
story.reading: i 'chat-jip', jeo hon-ja ol ttae-do ga-kkeum wa-yo. jo-yong-hae-seo.
story.en: I sometimes come to this 'tea house' alone too. It's quiet.
Try this 'tea'. Their jujube tea is famous here.

story.text: …좋은 '향기' 나네요. 차 말이에요, 딴 거 아니고.
story.reading: …jo-eun 'hyang-gi' na-ne-yo. cha mal-i-e-yo, ttan geo a-ni-go.
story.en: ...That's a nice 'fragrance'. I mean the tea, nothing else.

story.text: 자꾸 챙겨준다고 묻는다면… 그냥 '마음'이 그래요. 별 뜻 없어요.
story.reading: ja-kku chaeng-gyeo-jun-da-go mud-neun-da-myeon… geu-nyang 'ma-eum'i geu-rae-yo. byeol tteus eobs-eo-yo.
story.en: If you ask why I keep looking out for you... it's just how my 'heart' is. No special meaning.

story.text: …왜 그렇게 '미소' 지어요. 사람 이상하게 만들지 말고.
story.reading: …wae geu-reoh-ge 'mi-so' ji-eo-yo. sa-ram i-sang-ha-ge man-deul-ji mal-go.
story.en: ...Why are you 'smiling' like that. Don't make me feel strange.

story.text: …됐어요, 그만 물어봐요. 차 식기 전에 마셔요.
story.reading: …dwaess-eo-yo, geu-man mul-eo-bwa-yo. cha sik-gi jeon-e ma-syeo-yo.
story.en: ...Enough, stop asking. Drink the tea before it gets cold.

words.example_en: This tea house has a nice atmosphere.
Let's have a warm cup of tea.
A nice fragrance comes from the tea.
I wish you'd understand my heart.

sentences.en: I drink tea at the tea house.
The tea gives off a nice fragrance.
My heart feels at ease now.
I greet you with a smile.

sentences.ko: 향기로운 차 한잔이 마음을 편안하게 해요.
sentences.reading: hyang-gi-ro-un cha han-jan-i ma-eum-eul pyeon-an-ha-ge hae-yo
sentences.en: A fragrant cup of tea puts the heart at ease.
